Functions of NO, CO, and H2S
NO, CO, and H2S are produced from L-arginine, heme (formed from glycine), and L-cysteine, respectively. NO synthase and heme
oxygenase are wide-spread in human tissues. By contrast, H2S is synthesized by cystathionase in the liver, kidneys, enterocytes, and
